scientific_integrity: A fully analytic proof establishes the mass-only sharp coalescence threshold and collision exclusion, with supplementary reproducible symbolic and numerical tests. The comparator manuscripts concerning equal charges and L1 lower bounds are credited as prior inputs; novelty is conditional on incomplete older literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify noncoalesced minimizers above zero below threshold. Applies only to strictly positive residues, one distinguished boundary pole, and quadratic power-weighted disk Bergman norms. A potentially relevant generalized preprint was available only by abstract; historical priority may require broader examination. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Sharp mass-only antipodal coalescence threshold for weighted Bergman boundary poles
